result.summary: The home screen is mostly well laid out. The main visual defect is a loading spinner stuck on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, which suggests the image is still loading or has failed. Some minor styling inconsistencies also show up in the cards.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner (white circle with a green arc) is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image. The image looks partially rendered, so it is either stuck loading or the spinner was not removed after loading. It covers the main subject of the image and makes the card look broken.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image has loaded, and add a timeout with a fallback or retry state. Use a skeleton or blurred placeholder instead of a spinner over the content.

issues.description: The time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') overlap the bottom edge of the food illustrations and sit close to the card edge. On the first card the badge partly covers the plate, which looks cramped.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent padding and position the badges so they do not cover the image subject, for example by anchoring them to a corner with a fixed margin.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons are white on semi-transparent dark circles over busy images. The pizza card's icon has weak separation from the background. The gray secondary text (delivery fees, 'Search', 'Orders', 'Profile' labels) also has fairly low contrast on white.
issues.suggestion: Use a more opaque background behind the favorite icons, and darken the secondary gray text and inactive tab labels to meet WCAG AA contrast of 4.5:1.

issues.description: The promo banner has decorative translucent circles that are cut off awkwardly at the bottom-right corner, leaving a slightly odd edge artifact next to the rounded corner.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes cleanly inside the card's rounded container, or adjust their position so they do not create a visible seam.
